title: A Uniformly High-Accuracy PML-BIE Method for Scattering by Periodic Arrays of Obstacles: The 2D Case
summary: This paper presents a novel frequency-robust perfectly matched layer (PML) boundary integral equation (BIE) method for solving two-dimensional electromagnetic scattering problems involving periodic arrays of obstacles. In periodic scattering problems, standard BIE formulations based on the quasi-periodic Green's function require the evaluation of lattice sums or challenging Sommerfeld-type integrals, which diverge at Rayleigh--Wood (RW) anomalies.
